prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a low-speed head-on collision in Conroe, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1394; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but you can use the claim file reference.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were and what you were doing when the collision happened?

A: I was driving north on a two-lane road in Conroe, heading to the grocery store. It was early afternoon and traffic was light.

Q: Which direction was the other vehicle traveling?

A: It was coming south toward me. It drifted into my lane as it came around a slight curve. I tried to steer right, but we still hit nose to nose.

Q: How fast would you estimate you were going?

A: Maybe twenty-five miles an hour. I was braking when it happened, so I don't think it was very fast.

Q: Did either airbag deploy?

A: Yes, mine did. It was loud and the steering wheel jerked my arm.

Q: Did you get out of the vehicle on your own or need assistance?

A: I got out on my own, but my left wrist hurt right away. I couldn't grip anything. A neighbor drove me to urgent care.

Q: Have you received a diagnosis for your wrist?

A: Yes, they said it was fractured. I have a splint now and I'm waiting to see a hand specialist.

Q: Did you have any prior injuries to that wrist?

A: No, nothing I can recall.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I was following the rules of the road. I just want this handled fairly.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
